## 4\. Who can study Automobile Engineering in Sweden

The requirements for students applying for a bachelor’s program in automobile, vehicle or mechanical engineering are generally as follows. Understanding Automobile Engineering Eligibility in Sweden can help students identify suitable programs.
Educational qualification: Class 12 pass or equivalent secondary-school qualification.
Mathematics and Physics are essential . Chemistry may be required .
Academic performance Applicants are required to meet the university’s academic entry requirements.
English language proficiency: If the program is taught in English you may need to have IELTS, TOEFL or other accepted qualification.
Swedish language: Programs in Swedish require proof of Swedish proficiency at the level specified by the university.

Eligibility is dependent on the institution and the program and applicants should check the official entry requirements before applying. Automobile Engineering Eligibility in Sweden may vary depending on whether students choose automobile, vehicle or mechanical engineering.
## 5\. Admission Requirements to Study Automobile Engineering in Sweden

Universities look at candidates’ previous education, subject qualifications and language ability. Some programs may also have specific selection or documentation criteria. Students planning to Study Automobile Engineering in Sweden should review the admission requirements of their selected university.

The students are required to bring their academic records from Class 10 and Class 12, proof of English or Swedish proficiency, as applicable, and identification documents. Also, applicants must check that their school qualification meets Sweden's general entry requirements.

For instance, Jönköping University’s English-taught bachelor’s program in Mechanical Engineering is a three-year, 180-credit degree with a particular entry academic profile. It is a related engineering option, not an automobile engineering degree per se.
## 6\. Automobile Engineering Course Fees in Sweden

The total cost will depend on the university, program, and nationality of the student. Students from outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland usually pay tuition fees unless they are exempt. Automobile Engineering Fees in Sweden can therefore vary according to the university and the selected engineering program.
### Cost of Studying in Sweden

Example of tuition fees: Jönköping University charges a total tuition fee of SEK 510,000 for its English-taught bachelor’s program in Mechanical Engineering for the 2027 intake. This is a related engineering program, not a dedicated degree in automobile engineering. Students considering this option should understand the difference before applying.
The total tuition fee of SEK 510,000 is for the full three-year programme. Students should check the university's official fee schedule for the applicable instalment amounts and payment deadlines.

For students exploring Automobile Engineering Fees in Sweden, it is important to compare the tuition fees of the actual degree selected rather than assuming that all automotive-related programs have the same cost.
Students should budget for accommodation, food, insurance (where applicable), transport and other living expenses separately. Always check the university website for up-to-date tuition fees.
## 7\. How to get admission in Automobile Engineering in Sweden?
The general admission process is as follows:
Select a program: Automobile Engineering, Vehicle Engineering and Mechanical Engineering options comparison.
Verify eligibility: Check the academic subjects, grades and language requirements.
Prepare the documents: Collect transcripts, test results and language certificates.
Submit Application: Apply via the university official route or Sweden’s central admissions portal, depending on the program.
Pay the required fee. Pay the application fee, if any.
Read the ruling: Check your university’s admission decision and follow the instructions.
Arrange tuition and accommodation formalities: If you are admitted, pay the tuition in the required instalment and follow the applicable student residence-permit procedure.

Between 16 October 2026 and 15 January 2027 University Admissions will open the first international application round for many programs starting in Autumn 2027\. Please check the program page for specific dates as these may vary.

## 8\. Ongoing Education and Career Enhancement
Graduates earning a bachelor's degree in automobile or mechanical engineering can pursue advanced study in fields such as:
Automotive and Vehicle Engineering Electric and Hybrid Vehicle Technologies
Mechanical Engineering.
Robotics and Mechatronics
Automotive Design & Manufacturing
Sustainable Transport
Vehicle Control and Safety Systems

A master’s degree can help students specialize in electric mobility, autonomous vehicles, advanced vehicle design or automotive research and development. Students should check the entry requirements of each master program. These options can also help students who Study Automobile Engineering in Sweden plan their future academic and professional development.
## 9\. Salary and Career Opportunities
Graduates possessing the relevant engineering knowledge may pursue a career in automotive, manufacturing, transport and mobility sectors. Possible careers include:
Automotive Design Engineer
Vehicle Systems Engineer
Mechanical Design Engineering
Automotive Test Engineer
Manufacturing Engineer Electric Vehicle Systems Engineer Quality and Production Engineer
R\&D Engineer

The amount you earn and the type of job you get will depend on your experience, your technical and language skills, the employer and the location. Learning Swedish could open up some local opportunities, particularly if you have to communicate with manufacturing teams or customers.
## 10\. Documents Needed for Enrollment
According to the university’s checklist, students have to prepare the following documents:
Marksheets and certificates of Class 10 and Class 12
Passport. Valid passport
Proof of English language proficiency where required
Swedish-taught programs: evidence of Swedish proficiency
Academic records, subject specific
Certified translations of documents not submitted in the original language
Confirmation of application and fee receipt, if applicable
Other forms or program specific documents requested by the university
Students may also be required to have financial documentation and other supporting documents for residence permit formalities after receiving an offer.

sections.title: Can I do automobile engineering in Sweden after 12th?
sections.lead: Yes. If you meet the academic and language requirements, you can apply for a suitable bachelor’s program. See if the university has a specific automobile engineering degree or a mechanical or vehicle engineering program. Indian students planning Automobile Engineering in Sweden should compare the available options before choosing a course.

sections.title: Are bachelor's programs in automobile engineering in Sweden taught in English?
sections.lead: There are some related engineering programs taught in English, but dedicated automotive or vehicle engineering programs might be Swedish taught. Check the language of instruction for your selected intake.

sections.title: How long does it take to earn a bachelor’s degree in automotive engineering?
sections.lead: A typical bachelor’s degree is normally 3 years or 180 ECTS credits. Some integrated engineering courses are of 5 years duration.

sections.title: What subjects should I take in class 12?
sections.lead: Mathematics and physics are of special importance. Some universities will also require other subject specific qualifications such as chemistry.

sections.title: What can I do after studying automobile engineering in Sweden?
sections.lead: There are opportunities in vehicle design, testing, manufacturing, electric vehicle technology, quality control and research and development. You can also take a relevant master’s to go even more specialized.
